title: Yangon vs Mandalay: Which Should You Visit?
verdict: Yangon for food, colonial atmosphere, and easier logistics. Mandalay for temples, royal history, and Bagan access.

categories.name: Temples & Landmarks
categories.summary: Shwedagon is one of Asia's greatest religious monuments. Mandalay has more total temples but Shwedagon wins on impact.

categories.name: Food & Dining
categories.summary: Yangon has Myanmar's most diverse food scene. Mandalay has good local specialties but less variety.

categories.name: Cost
categories.summary: Mandalay is marginally cheaper across accommodation and day-to-day spending.

categories.name: Safety (2025-2026)
categories.summary: Yangon is away from active conflict zones. Mandalay is closer to Sagaing fighting area.

categories.name: Getting Around
categories.summary: Grab works in Yangon. Mandalay requires negotiated taxis.

categories.name: Day Trips
categories.summary: U Bein Bridge, Inwa, and Bagan proximity make Mandalay the better day-trip base.

categories.name: International Access
categories.summary: Yangon has far better international airport connections.
